items.a: Docivo is a free suite of PDF tools that run in your browser. Merge, split, convert, and OCR documents without installing anything. Local tools process files entirely on your device — nothing is uploaded.

items.q: Are my files uploaded to a server?
items.a: For local tools (Merge, Split, Image to PDF): absolutely not. Everything happens in your browser using pdf-lib. For cloud tools (OCR, PDF to Word): files are uploaded temporarily, processed, and deleted immediately after delivery.
PDF input for all tools. Image input (JPG, PNG, WebP) for Image to PDF. Output formats: PDF, .docx (PDF to Word). OCR adds a searchable text layer to existing PDFs.

items.q: Is there a file size limit?
items.a: Local tools have no strict limit — they process whatever your browser can handle. Cloud tools support files up to 50MB per upload. We're working on increasing this limit.

items.q: Do I need to create an account?
items.a: No. All tools work instantly with no account. Just upload your file and use it.
Local tools are 100% private — files never leave your device. Cloud tools use encrypted connections, process your file, and delete it immediately. We never store, read, or share your documents.

items.q: Can I use Docivo on mobile?
items.a: Docivo works on any modern browser, including mobile Safari and Chrome. The interface is fully responsive. Some advanced features work best on desktop.
